description: List all saved searches for the current user. Returns each search with its ID, query, filters, alert settings, and last run time. Use this FIRST to check what the user already has before creating or updating searches. Response includes remaining slots and plan info. Saved searches are available on every plan, including Free (Free: 1 saved search with weekly email alerts, Plus: 10, Pro: 25). Does not count toward your monthly searches.
name: list_saved_searches
title: List Saved Searches
